id: title:frankh:stop live tail poller crashing on unmount

review.posthog_relevance: Prevents runtime errors and potential polling behavior changes in the LogsViewer component, a shared frontend utility.
review.reason: P1.F2.H3 implements a guard against dispatching actions against an unmounted Kea logic instance, preventing a runtime error ('[KEA] Can not find path ...') when unmounting the LogsViewer component while a live-tail polling request is pending. P1.F2.H2 also contributes this guard. P1.F2.H3 additionally adds a dependency to the polling action, which could change polling behavior, but
review.uncertainty: The exact impact of the dependency graph change on polling behavior is not demonstrated; it could be benign or could introduce subtle behavior changes. The benefit is bounded to the LogsViewer component and its live-tail polling, not a systemic architectural change.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains four hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a test-only change and does not demonstrate implementation or benefit. P1.F2.H1 adds a prop dependency to listeners; P1.F2.H2 and P1.F2.H3 together implement the guard against unmounting while an async request is in flight. observations.behavior: Adds a guard against dispatching actions against an unmounted Kea logic instance.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents the '[KEA] Can not find path ...' runtime error when unmounting the LogsViewer component while a live-tail polling request is still pending, which could occur if the abort and unmount happen concurrently.

observations.behavior: Adds a prop dependency to the listeners object, potentially changing the dependency graph and when listeners are re-evaluated.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the dependency graph of the listeners, potentially affecting when the polling behavior is re-evaluated. This could change the behavior of the polling, potentially causing it to run more often or less often than before.
